svg.aria-label: Agent ID-card press: an agent's ID card rides a feed rail into a stamping press whose lit orange head stamps it official; three dials behind the press read WHO the agent is, how much SCOPE it was granted, and which OWNER is accountable; the stamped card lands in the output tray and the verification lamp lights. The press is the Wuzhen convention: 924 generative AI services filed by June 2026, 140 trillion daily token calls by March 2026, a 21.2 billion yuan enterprise agent market in 2025.
